system.description:
You can reshape the environment into one where it protects you and your allies. Jutsu you cast with the Fire or Earth release keywords, with a range of Self, that provides you temporary hit points, DR, or summons a Barrier, for you, gin a range of 30 feet and can be cast targeting a willing allied creature, applying its effect to the select creature as if they cast it. Additionally, Earthen Artifacts, within your Molten Terrain, that don’t have listed hit points, gain 20 hit points

Intensity I: Allied creatures within your Molten Terrain, have resistance to Bludgeoning, piercing, slashing and lightning damage. Additionally, by spending 4 of an Earthen Artifacts hit points that is within your Molten Terrain, you gain grant one allied creature, also within your Molten Terrain, one additional resistance that lasts until the beginning of your next turn.

Intensity II: If you have an active Earthen Artifact that has its own hit points, allied creatures within your Molten Terrain that take damage, can have up to half of the damage they take, transferred to the Earthen Artifact. If the damage they would transfer to the Earthen Artifact would exceed its current hit points, any remaining transferred damage goes back to the original ally.
